waterDamage.covered: sudden and accidental discharge of water (e.g. burst pipe, appliance failure)
exclusions: gradual seepage or leakage occurring over 14 days or more
wear and tear, deterioration, or corrosion
damage the insured knew of and failed to mitigate

fire.covered: direct loss from fire and smoke, including damage caused by fire-department response and reasonable emergency mitigation
exclusions: arson by or at the direction of the insured
fire arising from illegal activity at the premises
